messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming.tail_latency.p99 has spiked above 1200ms for route /v1/stream (eu-west). Affected model: redwood-open-13b-int8-eu. Auto-scaling healthy. Paging eng-sre/oncall. Graph: https://metrics.company/internal/streams/p99?range=15m :rotating_light:

maya: acked. I'm oncall for SRE. grabbing pprof and router traces now. any recent deploys or calibration rollouts?

aj: @maya we rolled int8 calibration batch rollout earlier at 12:03 UTC (rollout id: rollout/2026-03-14-int8-78). Canary passed but full ramp hit ~12:15.

lia: sequence-length distribution shifted overnight (longer contexts from a partner). the int8 profile was tuned for median seq len 128; tails may be undercalibrated -> dequant/cache thrash.

eric: routing shows increased failover to streaming nodes in eu-west-2a and small KV cache eviction spikes. forwarding to eng-runtime.

maya: collecting pprof on affected worker (worker-id w-az2-7f). stack traces show stalls in dequant::apply_kernel loop. dumping /var/log/redwood/runtime/worker.log (snippet):
```
[12:17:42] WARN kv_cache: eviction_count=12432
[12:17:42] WARN dequant: fallback-path engaged for layer 9
[12:17:43] ERR stream: stalled for 1870ms token_write
[12:17:44] INFO model: redwood-open-13b-int8-eu quant_profile=auto-calib-78
```

aj: that matches suspicion. int8 calib introduced a slow path for long sequences when prefix KV misses happen. we should flip routing to the fp16 pool for the hot route to restore latency. also consider throttling rollout.

piotr: I'm paged in (eng-runtime). I'll prepare a quick rollback toggle for the calibration flag and increase fp16 routing weight.

emma-csm: CS update: two enterprise customers on eu-west streaming reported degraded UX and 5–10% increase in reconnects over last 20m. Tickets: CS-4019, CS-4021. they're asking for ETA and mitigation.

piotr: mitigation plan (executing now):
1) set route /v1/stream model override -> redwood-open-13b-fp16-eu (weight 80%)
2) throttle calibration rollout (pause rollout/2026-03-14-int8-78)
3) enable debug KV hotcache for affected nodes

aj: commands:
```bash
redwood route update --route "/v1/stream" --model redwood-open-13b-fp16-eu --weight 0.8 --region eu-west
redwood rollout pause --id rollout/2026-03-14-int8-78
redwood node annotate w-az2-7f --kv-hotcache=on
```

piotr: executed route update and paused rollout. new traffic shows immediate p99 drop on router side. monitoring CPU/gpu.

maya: observed p95/p99 before mitigation (15m window): p95=340ms, p99=1180ms, streaming stall rate 3.4%. after route flip (2m): p95=220ms, p99=310ms, stall rate 0.4%.

emma-csm: passing note to customers: "We have applied a targeted routing mitigation and paused the recent int8 calibration rollout. Engineering is monitoring and will follow up with root cause and timeline for safe re-rollout."

lia: preliminary root cause hypothesis: auto-calibrated int8 profile (auto-calib-78) underestimated activation range for deeper layers on long-context inputs causing repeated dequant fallsbacks which amplify KV misses and stall streaming I/O. needs re-calibration with tail-focused samples and an extra fallback mitigation path in runtime.

aj: next actions:
- eng-ml to re-run calibration with tail-weighted dataset and produce a narrower quant_profile that avoids slow paths
- eng-runtime to add a fast-path that bypasses dequant fallback for streaming tokens (safety checks required)
- ops to add automated rollout gates tied to streaming p99 thresholds and long-context telemetry

piotr: assigning owners: lia -> eng-ml (calib rework), aj -> eng-runtime (fast-path), maya -> eng-sre (rollback/playbook update), eric -> eng-platform (rollout gate).

maya: paging summary for oncall handoff:
- incident id: INC-2026-4932
- root cause: int8 calibration (auto-calib-78) mismatch for long sequences -> dequant fallback stalls
- mitigation: paused rollout + route override to fp16 pool (completed 12:23 UTC)
- impact: p99 reduced from ~1180ms -> ~310ms, customer reconnects down to baseline; 2 enterprise tickets notified
- follow-ups: postmortem + calibration re-run + rollout gating

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff to night SRE (maya -> night_oncall). Please acknowledge within 15m.

piotr: night_oncall acknowledged. I'll stay on standby for the re-roll once eng-ml has a validated profile.

emma-csm: I'll schedule a customer follow-up call for tomorrow 09:00 UTC and share the postmortem when ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation applied, monitoring. creating PM ticket INC-2026-4932 for postmortem and owners list. Closing page once metrics stable for 30m."
